changelog: BIM-Bot v2.7.3 — Navisworks that Claude can see, linked to Revit. NEW: navis_capture_view and navis_capture_clash return real images of the Navisworks view (clash items red/green, the rest see-through), plus a Clash Snapshots ribbon button and navis_export_clash_snapshots (one image per clash + CSV). NEW Navisworks <-> Revit bridge: navis_clash_to_revit selects and zooms both clashing elements in the right Revit model, revit_selection_to_navis finds the Revit selection in Navisworks, navis_recheck_clash, navis_clash_handoff_table (Revit ID pairs per discipline file) and navis_refresh_models — works on federated NWD models. FIXES: reliable Navisworks connection (auto-start, instant UI-thread wake, never off-thread), navis_connection_status diagnostics with a fix hint, fast failure when Navisworks is closed, usable item IDs and Revit Category search.
